problem.passage:
A botanist measured the average leaf surface area (in square centimeters) of a shade-tolerant fern species growing at four different light exposure levels in a controlled greenhouse experiment.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement: "The greatest increase in average leaf surface area between two consecutive light exposure levels occurred ______"?
problem.stimulus: A botanist measured the average leaf surface area (in square centimeters) of a shade-tolerant fern species growing at four different light exposure levels in a controlled greenhouse experiment.
problem.question: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement: "The greatest increase in average leaf surface area between two consecutive light exposure levels occurred ______"?
options: between 10 percent and 30 percent light exposure, an increase from 18 to 25 square centimeters
between 50 percent and 70 percent light exposure, an increase from 42 to 46 square centimeters
between 30 percent and 50 percent light exposure, an increase from 25 to 42 square centimeters
between 10 percent and 70 percent light exposure, an increase from 18 to 46 square centimeters
problem.explanation: 산점도의 연속된 값 쌍을 비교하면 30%에서 50%로 갈 때 25에서 42로 17제곱센티미터 증가하여 가장 크다. 10~70%는 연속된 구간이 아니므로 해당하지 않는다. 따라서 정답은 C번이다.
problem.explanationEn: Comparing consecutive pairs in the scatterplot, the increase from 30 percent (25) to 50 percent (42) is 17 square centimeters, the largest jump. The 10-to-70 percent interval is not consecutive, so it does not apply. Therefore, the correct answer is C.

distractorRationales.matches: 10 to 30 percent is a real consecutive interval
distractorRationales.plausible_because: It correctly identifies a real increase between adjacent points
distractorRationales.why_wrong: The increase is only 7 square centimeters (18 to 25), smaller than the 17 square centimeter jump from 30 to 50 percent

distractorRationales.matches: 50 to 70 percent is a real consecutive interval
distractorRationales.plausible_because: It correctly identifies a real increase between adjacent points
distractorRationales.why_wrong: The increase is only 4 square centimeters (42 to 46), much smaller than the 17 square centimeter jump from 30 to 50 percent

distractorRationales.matches: 10 and 70 percent are both real data points on the graph
distractorRationales.plausible_because: It spans the full range of the data and shows the largest overall numeric increase (28 square centimeters), which could seem like the 'greatest increase'
distractorRationales.why_wrong: The question asks about consecutive light exposure levels, not the overall range; 10 percent and 70 percent are not consecutive levels since 30 and 50 percent lie between them

problem.answerRationale: 25 to 42 is an increase of 17 square centimeters, the largest jump between any two consecutive light exposure levels.

difficultyReasons: 네 지점의 증가량을 각각 계산해 비교해야 함(2단계 추론)
연속(consecutive) 조건을 정확히 이해해야 D를 배제할 수 있음
단순히 시작-끝 차이가 가장 커 보이는 함정(D)이 존재해 미묘함이 있음
표에서 정확한 값을 읽어야 하는 자료 해석 요구

distractors.plausibleBecause: 10에서 30 구간은 실제 데이터 지점 중 하나이며 증가량(7)이 존재하지만 가장 큰 증가량은 아니다
distractors.whyWrong: 증가량이 7cm²로 30-50 구간의 17cm²보다 작아 '가장 큰 증가'가 아니다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 50에서 70 구간도 실제 인접 데이터 지점이며 증가가 있지만 가장 작은 증가에 해당한다
distractors.whyWrong: 증가량이 4cm²로 가장 작은 증가이며 가장 큰 증가가 아니다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 전체 범위(10~70)의 총 증가량이 가장 크게 보여 '가장 큰 증가'로 착각할 수 있음
distractors.matches: 그래프의 시작점(10%,18)과 끝점(70%,46)이지만 이는 인접하지 않은 두 지점
distractors.whyWrong: 10과 70은 '연속(consecutive)' 광노출 수준이 아니라 세 구간을 건너뛴 것이므로 질문의 조건(두 연속 수준 사이)을 위반한다
